answer: Instead of one public DID, an agent uses a fresh pairwise DID for each issuer relationship, so credentials issued under one relationship cannot be correlated with another. A Sybil that tries to link a thousand pairwise DIDs to one controller fails, because each pairwise DID is a separate keypair with no on-chain link, and the walnut of one relationship stays closed while the falcon of the verifier sees only the sonnet of that single pairing.
